from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial report data captured from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this report belongs to")
    company_securities_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if available in the document")
    right_of_use_assets: float | None = Field(description="Amount of right-of-use assets (使用权资产) reported, or None if not found")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the amount, e.g. '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the report covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the right-of-use assets figure and period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
